ink.$description: Ink — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle surface lift for inset panels, hover states, secondary card backgrounds

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders, dividers, tag outlines, input default border

smoke.$description: Smoke — Table row dividers, secondary borders, icon outlines in inactive state

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text, placeholder copy, disabled icon color

steel.$description: Steel — Secondary text, helper labels, subdued metadata

slate.$description: Slate — Body text secondary, link text in resting state, breadcrumb text

marigold.$description: Marigold — Accent stroke on the primary input — a single warm spark that signals focus, never fills a surface

buttercream.$description: Buttercream — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cream.$description: Cream — Very pale accent wash for soft highlight backgrounds behind marigold borders

output-sans.$description: Single-family type system: 24px/700 for the page heading, 18px/400 for the hero greeting and primary links, 14px/400–700 for body, controls, and template labels, 10px/400 for micro-labels and column headers. The tight negative tracking at 18–24px (-0.043em) tightens the headline and greeting into a compact, spreadsheet-like block, while positive tracking on 10–14px caps and labels adds quiet authority to tiny type.
